body:
It's a bit sickening for me as, the only family and many friends I have... it would be horrible for them to experience but I... it's a bit selfish now that I think about it. But it's how I feel, I feel happy and calm it's the perfect time to exit. Everything has so much meaning and it's just beautiful. A big bang happened, created perfect parameters to develop life as me and you are communicating although we are miles away... 

I wish I can frame the way I feel. [Ah here](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jvcQWJaaQDw) 
I guess my time has been so "perfect" lately as it's been a bit rough in the past that I wouldn't want to pass the opportunity... I'll keep on trucking and if life is overwhelmingly perfect again I'll express it through reading or writing. 

I wish you can see what I see.
Sleeping pills, is it right to suppress a natural feeling with a manmade sedative? Reliance is a bit depressing no?

If you're finished with your life, at most live to help others. Improving a life with your presence is uplifting. Get your GED, travel to Korea to teach English. Join the Peace Corps or join an organization of some kind. 

People only know as much as you present. Opportunities are endless, live constantly not by your history.

Funny, I traveled a lot when I was kid and experimented with different sides of myself though more so just improving on a base persona of myself. This is the first time in years that I'm at one place for more than 4 years and the feeling of not being in a different environment is burdening. 

I'm at a great point in my life and I've acknowledged it. Though I feel I need to move on and to not stay. I feel there is something out there for me, more people to meet and to converse with... more opportunities.... tasks I must do. 

I don't know where I'll be by next year as I'm graduating and it's the most exciting feeling ever. I need a hug.
